script:
Script of the media (media): media: the TV on, off, louder, quieter; infrared devices by their remote's keys; refusals naming the blocker
- move tv up: "I turn {T} on."; needs cmd tv on(T), tv off(T), tv ok(T) (kept); leaves tv on(T), done(on).
- move tv on already: "{T} is already on."; needs cmd tv on(T), tv on(T) (kept); leaves refused(on).
- move tv on missing: "I can't turn {T} on: it does not answer."; needs cmd tv on(T), tv off(T) (kept), tv missing(T) (kept); leaves refused(on).
- move tv down: "I turn {T} off."; needs cmd tv off(T), tv on(T), tv ok(T) (kept); leaves tv off(T), done(off).
- move tv off already: "{T} is already off."; needs cmd tv off(T), tv off(T) (kept); leaves refused(off).
- move tv off missing: "I can't turn {T} off: it does not answer."; needs cmd tv off(T), tv on(T) (kept), tv missing(T) (kept); leaves refused(off).
- move tv louder: "I turn {T} up."; needs cmd tv louder(T), tv on(T) (kept), tv ok(T) (kept); leaves done(volume).
- move tv quieter: "I turn {T} down."; needs cmd tv quieter(T), tv on(T) (kept), tv ok(T) (kept); leaves done(volume).
- move louder off: "{T} is off: there is no sound to change."; needs cmd tv louder(T), tv off(T) (kept); leaves refused(volume).
- move quieter off: "{T} is off: there is no sound to change."; needs cmd tv quieter(T), tv off(T) (kept); leaves refused(volume).
- move tv on unknown: "I can't: there is no such TV in this home."; needs cmd tv on(tx); leaves refused(on).
- move tv off unknown: "I can't: there is no such TV in this home."; needs cmd tv off(tx); leaves refused(off).
- move ir unknown: "I can't: no device I know answers to that remote."; needs cmd ir(irx,K), ir ready (kept); leaves refused(ir).
- move louder unknown: "I can't: there is no such TV in this home."; needs cmd tv louder(tx); leaves refused(volume).
- move quieter unknown: "I can't: there is no such TV in this home."; needs cmd tv quieter(tx); leaves refused(volume).
- move ir send: "I press {K} on the remote of {D}."; needs cmd ir(D,K), ir ready (kept); leaves sent(D,K), done(ir).
- move ir none: "I can't reach {D}: the infrared remote is not connected yet."; needs cmd ir(D,K), ir absent (kept); leaves refused(ir).
- move sweep tv: "I turn {T} off for the scene."; needs sweep tv off(T), tv on(T), tv ok(T) (kept); leaves tv off(T), switched(T).
- move sweep tv kept: "{T} was already off."; needs sweep tv off(T), tv off(T) (kept); leaves kept(T).
- move sweep tv missed: "I could not turn {T} off: it does not answer."; needs sweep tv off(T), tv on(T) (kept), tv missing(T) (kept); leaves missed(T).
- things it counts: occupied; empty; vacant; unsensed; someone home; nobody home; home unsensed; day; night; running; stopped; heater on; heater off; unit ok; unit missing; on b; power; entered; left home; came home; dawn; tv on; tv off; tv ok; tv missing; ir ready; ir absent; cmd tv on; cmd tv off; cmd tv louder; cmd tv quieter; cmd ir; sweep tv off; done; refused; switched; kept; missed; sent
